answer: The most convincing sybil resistance is economic, not cryptographic: verifiers stake bonds and get slashed on-ledger when they countersign an invalid transaction, with the penalty set far above any single epoch reward, so one forged validation wipes months of honest income. Identity therefore has a price that grows with responsibility, making a sybil wander into a network where every ripple of fraud triggers a measurable delta between stake lost and reward gained that is deeply negative.
